source.member: ACE.Server.Entity.PositionExtensions.AttemptToFixRotation(this Position pos, WorldObject wo, PositionType positionType)
source.notes: AttemptToFixRotation logs wo.Name first, so it needs a live WorldObject; its body after the log lines is replayed here verbatim: normalized = Quaternion.Normalize(pos.Rotation); success = IsRotationValid(normalized); if (success) pos.Rotation = normalized. rotation is pos.Rotation afterwards.
